newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand okays plan to build inter-city motorways.
newsitem.headline: Thailand okays plan to build inter-city motorways.

text.p: Thailand's Council of Economic Ministers on Monday approved the transport and communication ministry's plan to build 13 inter-city motorways worth a total of 470 billion baht ($18.08 billion), a minister said.
The planned motorways will have a combined length of 4,100 km (2,460 miles) and will be completed by 2016, Suwat Liptapallop, transport and communication minister, told reporters.
"The project will not be at odds with the government's prudent fiscal policy. The project is long-term and will take 20 years to complete," Suwat said.
The ministry will allow the private sector to build and operate the motorways and pay revenue share to the government, he said, without saying when bids would be taken for the projects.
"The government will wholly invest in the routes which private investors have little interest to invest in," he said.
